tools.name: Count documents mentioning a phrase
tools.description: Scan every selected document and count distinct documents containing a literal phrase, ignoring letter case. Counts documents, not people or votes. Returns example passages.

tools.name: Extract numbered bibliographies
tools.description: List research references from recognized numbered bibliographies in selected documents. Each entry retains its original number and supporting passage IDs. Unsupported formats are reported explicitly.

tools.name: Find duplicate original files
tools.description: Find selected documents whose saved originals have identical content hashes. This detects exact file copies, not paraphrases or semantically similar documents.

tools.name: Compare document passages
tools.description: Compare two selected document IDs by exact indexed passage text. Return added and removed passages with evidence. Chunk boundaries can change when a file is edited; this is a textual comparison, not a semantic judgment.
